prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated clump of wetland reeds, for a stone-age top-down settlement game. Both attached images are locked style references: props anchors fine ink edges, restrained wash and natural materials; scene anchors overhead camera, muted olive earth palette and upper-left light. Match them precisely. View vertically from above: a small tuft of slender green-ochre blades splaying radially from a compact base, with a few slender brown seed heads, only a tiny south-facing stem/trunk front-face cheat where relevant. Fine controlled dark ink linework, restrained olive and warm sage wash, two-tone upper-left lighting, crisp natural foliage groupings. Center one complete plant with 10% margin on uniform solid #FF00FF magenta. No ground, cast shadow, scenery, frame, labels or text. No isometric camera, photo, 3D render, pixel art or gradient blur. Output square 1024px image.
